items.description:
This is for archival purposes only. But I'm presenting you every single DVD extras of How I Met Your Mother. I haven't seen anyone uploaded it in higher quality, so I'm presenting it in untouched form.

Anyways,  I did had access to the entire series on DVD and remux e

items.description: <div>Three different endings were made for the long-running series "How I Met Your Mother", described as the Happy Ending, the Sad Ending and the Tragic Ending. Only one was aired at the time, the remaining two have been included in special releases since. This collection collates all three together
